messages:
Sam: FYI, we saw a spike of failed scale-ups in eu-west-1 last night during large spot churn. ~30% of new launches timed out and some VMs never attached their ENIs.
Marta: saw alerts. the nodes that did come up were stuck in CNI init; kubelet logs show DHCP timeouts and "no such device" when calling ip link.
Conor: did we push any AMI/kernel changes recently? I'm thinking the kernel module path change could have broken the CNI package on new images.
Sam: yes, AMI roll on Tuesday. correlates with failures; older AMIs don't show the ENI attach errors. weirdly it's only in certain AZs in eu-west-1.
Rajesh: our mixed-pool selection is currently favoring one instance family in those AZs which has lower ENI limits per instance. when combined with many small allocations, we hit ENI saturation.
Marta: mitigation proposal: 1) rollback the AMI in the affected AZs via tag-based selection, 2) in the short-term bias instance selection toward types with higher max-eni, 3) add per-AZ preferred list to avoid the saturated zones.
Sam: sketch of a Terraform canary change we can apply (small parallelism, per-region LT map, instance weighting, rollout tag):
```hcl
module "spot_gpu_pool" {
  source = "../modules/spot-pool"
  region = var.region
  preferred_launch_template = lookup(var.launch_templates_by_region, var.region, var.default_launch_template)
  instance_type_weights = {
    p4d_24 = 6
    g5_24  = 4
    g4dn_x = 1
  }
  max_parallel_launch = var.scale_up > 25 ? 6 : 12
  tags = merge(var.common_tags, { rollout_tag = "ami-canary-2026-03-20" })
}
```
Conor: also add a fallback_azs list and a small boot-time smoke test (curl metadata service + quick kubelet register check). If smoke test fails within 90s, terminate and mark instance for investigation.
Liz: note on cost: if we bias away from certain cheaper families we could see a rise in GPU-hour cost. recommend a price-hysteresis: only shift weighting if spot price > baseline * 1.25 for >10m to avoid oscillation.
Rajesh: i'll add the hysteresis var and a small script that samples the price feed every 30s and writes a short history to s3 for autoscaler to consult.
Sam: infra-bot run a terraform plan (canary) for eu-west-1 and show expected changes + instance mix
infra-bot: running terraform plan (canary) for eu-west-1... summary attached
infra-bot: plan: update 2 modules, add 1 variable, modify 3 launch template overrides. Estimated instance mix (weighted): p4d-family 22%, g5-family 38%, g4dn-family 40%
Marta: add post-create hook to the ASG with local-exec that runs small script: curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id && systemctl is-active kubelet && timeout 90 bash -c 'kubelet --version' || exit 1
Conor: good. that'll prevent half-baked nodes from holding ENIs. Also reduce scale_up concurrency for the next 30m while we watch.
Sam: proposed rollout plan:
- Apply canary TF in eu-west-1 with max_parallel_launch=6 and fallback_azs set (Marta)
- Tag the older AMI as ami-rollback-2026-03-12 in affected AZs and revert launch template overrides (Marta)
- Monitor ENI attach error rate, CNI init times, and kubelet join latency for 45 minutes (Sam + Liz)
- If metrics stable, increment parallelism to 15, enable price-hysteresis, continue roll to other regions
Owners: Marta (canary apply + AMI rollback), Rajesh (hysteresis + weighting PR), Conor (smoke test + AZ fallback), Liz (cost watch)
Sam: please paste plan outputs and ETA for the canary apply here. i'll coordinate paging if network errors spike.
Liz: will create a dashboard with GPU-hour unit cost and ENI-attach error rate; set alerts at 15% above baseline and 5% ENI error rate.
Marta: starting canary apply in ~20m, tagging resources with rollout_tag=ami-canary-2026-03-20. ping me if you need me to abort.
